notes.title: V1.1.2 brings more QoL changes
notes.notes:
- moved dialog panel to the top of the screen to not obstruct the buy ui and to reduce unwanted dialog skips
- lowered the threshold for several hair colors and increased the chance of hair dye events
- fixed some transformations not triggering correctly on cow and goblin specializations
- fixed a bug that triggered a medication effect on the current area instead of the one being upgraded when using Stochastic Fluctuation
